1. https://dbweekly.example/pool-exhaustion — "Connection pool exhaustion explained"
2. https://forum.example/t/pool-limits — "Why does my pool run dry?"

Here are some main causes of database connection pool exhaustion:

1. High concurrency: When multiple requests are made to the application simultaneously, the number of active connections can quickly exceed the limit set by the connection pool. This is especially common in web applications with high traffic.
2. Long-running transactions: If transactions take a long time to complete, they will hold onto database connections for extended periods, preventing other requests from acquiring them and causing the pool to exhaust.
3. Leaked connections: Sometimes, due to programming errors or bugs, database connections may not be properly closed after use, leading to their accumulation in the connection pool and eventual exhaustion.
